name: Amazon Redshift
description: Connect your own AWS account to manage Redshift provisioned clusters, Redshift Serverless workgroups, databases, and run SQL via the Redshift Data API, and audit warehouse cost and health -- from Imperal. Uses your own IAM Access Key -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

tools.name: connect_redshift
tools.description: Connect your own AWS account by saving an IAM Access Key ID + Secret Access Key, after checking it actually works against Redshift.

access_key_id.description: Your AWS IAM Access Key ID, e.g. AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE.
access_key_id.title: Access Key Id

secret_access_key.description: Your AWS IAM Secret Access Key.
secret_access_key.title: Secret Access Key

session_token.description: Optional session token for temporary/SSO credentials. Leave empty for a permanent access key.
session_token.title: Session Token

region.description: AWS region your Redshift clusters/workgroups live in, e.g. us-east-1.
region.title: Region

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected AWS accounts (for Redshift access).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_redshift
tools.description: Disconnect an AWS account: deletes the saved Access Key. Nothing in AWS itself is changed.

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: List Redshift provisioned clusters in the connected AWS account/region.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: Read one Redshift provisioned cluster in full by its identifier.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: delete_cluster
tools.description: Permanently delete a Redshift provisioned cluster. Cannot be undone unless a final snapshot is taken.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

skip_final_snapshot.description: If false (default), a final snapshot is taken before deletion.
skip_final_snapshot.title: Skip Final Snapshot

final_snapshot_identifier.description: Name for the final snapshot, required unless skip_final_snapshot is true.
final_snapshot_identifier.title: Final Snapshot Identifier

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: resize_cluster
tools.description: Resize a Redshift provisioned cluster -- change its node type and/or node count.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List snapshots for a Redshift provisioned cluster, or across the account if no cluster is given.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

cluster_identifier.description: Optional: filter to snapshots of one cluster.
cluster_identifier.title: Cluster Identifier

tools.name: list_workgroups
tools.description: List Redshift Serverless workgroups in the connected AWS account/region.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_workgroup
tools.description: Read one Redshift Serverless workgroup in full by its name.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List Redshift Serverless namespaces in the connected AWS account/region.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List databases available on a Redshift cluster or Serverless workgroup, via the Data API.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

cluster_identifier.description: Provisioned cluster identifier (set this OR workgroup_name).
cluster_identifier.title: Cluster Identifier

workgroup_name.description: Serverless workgroup name (set this OR cluster_identifier).
workgroup_name.title: Workgroup Name

database.description: Database to connect through for listing, e.g. 'dev'.
database.title: Database

db_user.description: Database user for provisioned clusters using temporary credentials (IAM auth).
db_user.title: Db User

secret_arn.description: Secrets Manager secret ARN holding DB credentials, alternative to db_user.
secret_arn.title: Secret Arn

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Run a SQL statement against Redshift (provisioned cluster or Serverless workgroup) via the Data API. Returns a statement id -- poll get_statement_status, then get_statement_result.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

cluster_identifier.description: Provisioned cluster identifier (set this OR workgroup_name).
cluster_identifier.title: Cluster Identifier

workgroup_name.description: Serverless workgroup name (set this OR cluster_identifier).
workgroup_name.title: Workgroup Name

database.description: Database to run the query against, e.g. 'dev'.
database.title: Database

db_user.description: Database user for provisioned clusters using temporary credentials (IAM auth).
db_user.title: Db User

secret_arn.description: Secrets Manager secret ARN holding DB credentials, alternative to db_user.
secret_arn.title: Secret Arn

sql.description: SQL statement to run, e.g. SELECT * FROM public.users LIMIT 100.
sql.title: Sql

tools.name: get_statement_status
tools.description: Read a SQL statement's current status by id from execute_sql -- whether it's done, and row/duration info.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_statement_result
tools.description: Read the result rows of a completed SQL statement by id from execute_sql.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

statement_id.description: Statement id returned by execute_sql, once its status is FINISHED.
statement_id.title: Statement Id

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_statements
tools.description: List recent SQL statements run via the Data API in the connected AWS account/region.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_redshift
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across the connected AWS account: publicly accessible clusters, clusters/workgroups with default settings that may indicate weak security posture.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: redshift_connections
secrets.description: Your connected AWS accounts for Redshift -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per account, each with its own IAM Access Key ID/Secret Access Key/session token and region. Managed through connect_redshift / disconnect_redshift -- you should not need to edit this directly.
